snippet.title: Ethereal Sunder - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Store: https://saikeystudios.com/product/ethereal-sunder/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=post
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3304760/Ethereal_Sunder/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=post

Step into the role of Eilayda, the Fairy Queen, on a mission to save her people from the deadly sickness. Make your way through the dangerous prison district of a human town- a place rumoured to have a cure, while facing ruthless criminals and moral choices at every turn. In this RPG game, you'll encounter countless trials that will put your resilience to the test. Will you keep your integrity, or be pulled into a world of corruption where laws hold no power?
